events.title: Adventists AI opens Sophon-Realtime for full-duplex voice agents
events.title_zh: Adventists AI 开放 Sophon-Realtime 语音模型
events.summary: Adventists AI released Sophon-Realtime v1, an Apache-2.0 full-duplex Chinese-English voice model family with Tag, Flash and E2E speech paths. Public weights and code run on one 80 GB GPU through vLLM-Omni or the project's engine, and a hosted OpenAI Realtime-compatible API offers a free trial. The publisher reports about 0.25 seconds to first audio for E2E and 48% Pass@1 on Full-Duplex-Bench v3.
events.why_it_matters: For teams building voice agents, public weights, barge-in handling and a familiar realtime API make an end-to-end trial practical. The quality, concurrency and latency numbers are mostly publisher-run, so production decisions still need independent bilingual, noisy-room and interruption tests.
events.summary_zh: Adventists AI 发布 Sophon-Realtime v1。这是一组支持中英文的 Apache-2.0 全双工语音模型，提供 Tag、Flash 与 E2E 三条语音路径。公开权重和代码可在单张 80 GB GPU 上通过 vLLM-Omni 或项目自带引擎运行，另有兼容 OpenAI Realtime 的托管 API 免费试用。发布方报告 E2E 首音频约 0.25 秒，Full-Duplex-Bench v3 Pass@1 为 48%。
events.summary_en: Adventists AI released Sophon-Realtime v1, an Apache-2.0 full-duplex Chinese-English voice model family with Tag, Flash and E2E speech paths. Public weights and code run on one 80 GB GPU through vLLM-Omni or the project's engine, and a hosted OpenAI Realtime-compatible API offers a free trial. The publisher reports about 0.25 seconds to first audio for E2E and 48% Pass@1 on Full-Duplex-Bench v3.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对开发语音 agent 的团队来说，公开权重、打断处理和兼容常见 realtime API 的接口让端到端试验可执行。质量、并发与延迟数字主要来自发布方，生产决策前仍需独立测试中英双语、噪声环境与连续打断。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building voice agents, public weights, barge-in handling and a familiar realtime API make an end-to-end trial practical. The quality, concurrency and latency numbers are mostly publisher-run, so production decisions still need independent bilingual, noisy-room and interruption tests.

technical_details.architecture: 32B shared listening and reasoning model with Tag, Flash and E2E speech generation paths
technical_details.availability: Public Hugging Face weights and GitHub code; hosted OpenAI Realtime-compatible API with a three-hour trial
technical_details.serving: One 80 GB GPU; Tag and Flash through vLLM-Omni; E2E through the project engine or vLLM-Omni
technical_details.publisher_benchmarks: E2E first audio about 0.25 s; Full-Duplex-Bench v3 Pass@1 48%; VoiceBench 82.8; Big Bench Audio 81.8%
technical_details.benchmark_limits: Sophon results are publisher-run; Full-Duplex-Bench reports the best of several runs and uses GPT-4o judging
technical_details.time_basis: Hugging Face repository created 2026-11-07T03:06:25Z; recovered as a recall-audit late discovery

technical_details_zh.可用性: Hugging Face 公开权重与 GitHub 代码；兼容 OpenAI Realtime 的托管 API 提供三小时试用

evidence.claim_zh: 官方 model card 与代码仓库确认 Apache-2.0 权重、单卡 serving 路径、打断处理与托管 API；性能数字尚未独立复现。
evidence.claim_en: The official model card and code repository confirm Apache-2.0 weights, single-GPU serving paths, interruption handling and a hosted API; performance numbers remain independently unverified.
evidence.verification: public artifacts verified; performance not independently reproduced
